Eligibility Criteria
“Get Real” Campaign Airdrop
Wallet Connection
: Requires an Ethereum-compatible wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect) connected to Peaq Network.
Quest Completion
: Engage with real-world DePIN applications like
Silencio
(noise pollution tracking) and
MapMetrics
(navigation data).
Earn
XP (Experience Points)
and
NP (Network Points)
to rank on the leaderboard.
Referral Bonus
: 1% XP from referred users.
Seasonal Participation
: Season 1 rewarded the top 100 with
2.1M PEAQ
, from a pool of
18.8M PEAQ
.
🔹
Season 2 is upcoming
with updated criteria—monitor Peaq’s official channels for announcements.
